claimsCompared.claim: Allocation includes cash and depends on time horizon and risk tolerance.
claimsCompared.assessment: Supported as general education. Neither source endorses the lessons hypothetical40/40/20 or50/50 targets; page explicitly labels them classroom inputs.

claimsCompared.claim: Price moves change portfolio weights and rebalancing can restore selected weights through sales, purchases or new cash.
claimsCompared.assessment: Supported. Beginner guide also explicitly requires considering transaction fees and tax consequences. No timing or return guarantee inferred.

claimsCompared.claim: Asset counts or multiple funds alone do not establish diversification; common exposures matter.
claimsCompared.assessment: Supported by between/within-category and narrowly focused fund/top-holdings cautions. Does not certify any real portfolio.

claimsCompared.claim: Non-interest-bearing virtual cash changes participation in rising/falling paths.
claimsCompared.assessment: Lesson classroom arithmetic independently recomputed:80000*1.1+20000=108000 versus110000;80000*.9+20000=92000 versus90000. Official sources discuss real cash equivalents with terms and inflation risk; they do not establish simulator cash interest or a required cash percentage.

claimsCompared.claim: Exact fee-aware50/50 sale in the crypto lesson.
claimsCompared.assessment: Independent algebra under stated0.1% sale fee, unchanged quote, no quantity rounding:S=10000/.9995=10005.00250125;holding60000-S=cash40000+.999*S=49994.99749875. Generic investor references do not validate TradeHQ fee implementation or real execution.

remaining: TradeHQ implementation/fee model and real execution are separate checks. API/feed/provider claims of the other lessons require their own primary sources. No whole-course/page/originality/accessibility/ad-policy certification. No data or site change.
